def fill_circulation(case,predictions,thresholds,r,f):
    # augment feasible circulation f to a maximal-flow feasible circulation in residual network
    K,R,Z,a,b,e,w,z,h,arcs=build_arcs(case,predictions,thresholds,r)
    if len(f)!=len(arcs): raise RuntimeError('length')
    # find ZR
    zr=[i for i,(u,v,l,hh,c) in enumerate(arcs) if u==Z and v==R]
    if len(zr)!=1: raise RuntimeError('zr')
    zri=zr[0]; zr_res=arcs[zri][3]-f[zri]
    if zr_res<=0:return f[:]
    di=Dinic(K)
    fmap=[]; bmap=[]
    for i,(u,v,l,hh,c) in enumerate(arcs):
        if i==zri: continue
        fmap.append(di.add(u,v,hh-f[i]))
        bmap.append(di.add(v,u,f[i]-l))
    flow=di.maxflow(R,Z,zr_res)
    if flow<=0:return f[:]
    g=[]
    for i,(u,v,l,hh,c) in enumerate(arcs):
        if i==zri:
            g.append(f[i]+flow); continue
        fu=di.cap[fmap[i]] if fmap[i]>=0 else 0
        bu=di.cap[bmap[i]] if bmap[i]>=0 else 0
        usedf=(hh-f[i])-fu
        usedb=(f[i]-l)-bu
        nf=f[i]+usedf-usedb
        if nf<l or nf>hh:
            raise RuntimeError(('fill bound',i,nf,l,hh))
        g.append(nf)
    # verify conservation
    bal=[0]*K
    for (u,v,l,hh,c),x in zip(arcs,g):bal[u]+=x;bal[v]-=x
    if any(bal):raise RuntimeError(('fill conservation',bal))
    return g
